evidence: Matches the 'Build system' label and modifies CMakeLists.txt to handle MSVC compiler detection.
rationale: Fails fast at CMake configuration time when unsupported cl.exe is invoked rather than clang-cl on Windows. Currently, invoking CMake without '--preset windows' or '-T ClangCL' silently creates broken project files that fail cryptically during compilation, so this provides a clearer error message and documentation pointer to reduce developer friction.
